data.title: City of Albuquerque School Crossings Dashboard
data.description:
This dashboard provides information about over 350 school crossings in the City of Albuquerque. Data is shown based on the crossing score and rating system developed during this evaluation. Tools are available to select particular schools, areas, and crossing features as well as sorting by rating.

Crossing ratings were updated in 2024 and will continue to be updated as needed. School locations and Walk Zones were provided by Albuquerque Public Schools and were last updated in 2022 with updated Walk Zone data expected in 2025.
